scopeQualifier: Passed within the sampled static model-view scope described below; no exhaustive-course visual claim.

scope.selection: Every theory card and the first selected exercise at each of A/B/C in each subsection. For every card: neutral and last declared non-neutral model view at 1280 px. Also neutral theory views at 320 px.

method: Actually viewed all 15 final contact sheets generated from these PNGs using view_image at original detail. Each cell shows the full model region including its border and labels. Also viewed two selected full screenshots at original detail to inspect dense labels and the compact plane. Hashes were computed for the same inspected files after final rendering.
checks: Figure and point-label legibility; clipping and excessive overlap within the sampled model regions.
Initial and final view comparison: source-given objects remain visible and the highlighted line/plane is distinguishable.
No computed numerical answers or concealed solution constructions visibly revealed in sampled initial figures. This is a visual screen inspection, not a new mathematical proof audit.
All 15 neutral mobile theory models remain within their figure areas and have readable labels.

resolvedFindings.finding: The earlier capture did not include the added section construction.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Final section view visibly contains M, N, M1, N1 and the highlighted quadrilateral.

resolvedFindings.finding: Distant auxiliary plane points reduced the useful prism size in the earlier capture; the caption named a different highlight color.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Final capture uses compact U/V and shows a larger prism. Caption now says «Выделенный треугольник». The final full screenshot was inspected.

observations.note: The small plane fragment is nearly edge-on in the default camera angle. K, U and V remain distinct at full size; rotation controls are present. No content or layout blocker was found.
L, K, T and X cluster near the apex by the source ratio. Full-size inspection shows separate readable labels; no overlap or clipping requiring a correction was found.

limits: This review covers 60 cards and 135 screenshots, not all 351 course cards.
Only neutral and last declared non-neutral desktop model views were visually sampled; intermediate views and other exercises were not visually inspected here.
Mobile coverage is neutral theory models only; it does not establish full mobile exercise coverage.
Most screenshots were inspected as model-region crops, so this report does not certify the surrounding learner navigation, answer entry, text flow, persistence or accessibility interactions.
The screenshots are from the engineering model preview. Interactive rotation and learner-state behavior were not exercised by this reviewer.
Source accuracy and all mathematical solutions are covered by separate content reviews, not inferred from these screenshots.
